business_problem: Hualvwang needed a way to help ordinary users describe legal issues more precisely, retrieve relevant legal knowledge faster and scale personalized legal-service triage across a very large user base.
solution_summary: Hualvwang used Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan large-model platform to build two tightly related legal-service features on top of its huge legal corpus. The first is the 'recommended questions' flow, which uses Baidu's generation, understanding, logic and memory capabilities to refine vague user requests into clearer legal-service intents and then steer users toward the right area of law, knowledge and follow-up services. The second is the 'Xiaolvxia' legal adviser, which can generate legal-opinion content from real-time consultations and follow-up questionnaire responses. Under the hood, the platform relies on more than two decades of Hualvwang knowledge assets, more than 900 million legal-knowledge entries and large-scale consultation data to ground model outputs in the site's own domain material. This turns the model from a generic chat interface into a two-sided platform asset: it improves user-side discovery and simultaneously helps the business assess lead value, connect people with appropriate legal experts and strengthen the site's content ecosystem.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Packages the legal-consultation application flows that sit on top of Baidu's large models.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development environment for legal-intent understanding and content generation.

solution_components.name: Recommended Questions
solution_components.role: Helps users narrow vague legal issues into clearer needs and service directions.

solution_components.name: Xiaolvxia Legal Adviser
solution_components.role: Generates legal-opinion content and structured assessments from user consultations.

data_flow: User legal questions enter the recommended-questions workflow, which uses domain knowledge and model reasoning to refine intent and retrieve relevant legal content; follow-up answers then feed the Xiaolvxia adviser, which generates legal opinions and assessment forms for downstream service routing.
business_outcome: Hualvwang improved legal-intent discovery, accelerated access to relevant knowledge and services and created a higher-volume, better-targeted legal-service funnel on top of its content assets.
